items.title: Report from the self-organizing conference
items.summary: Last week we hosted over a hundred and fifty AI practitioners in our offices for our first self-organizing conference on machine learning.
items.summaryZh: 本文回顾了OpenAI举办的首届机器学习自组织会议，记录了当时AI从业者的交流情况。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容为2016年的会议回顾，无实质性技术更新或产业价值。
